action_args.justification: The series is seasonality-dominated (strength 0.69) with weak trend, unstable model ranking (Kendall tau -0.185), and very high inter-model error correlation (mean 0.869). These characteristics favour a robust, unweighted combination over the full pool: the median is insensitive to the few models that spike in any given window, and subsetting (pools of 5, 7, 9) consistently degraded performance because the 'stable' models are not the same across windows. With only 3 validation windows, fitted weights carry high variance and the per-horizon best model rotates (ONLY_CWT_catboost → ETS → ONLY_CWT_rf), so no single model or small subset can be trusted. The full-pool median captures the seasonal signal through the collective while remaining robust to individual model failures.
